blurb: DeWolf Brewing Company is a craft brewery and restaurant in Victor, NY, serving house-brewed craft beer and Spanish-inspired food including tapas-style plates, smash burgers, sandwiches, salads, and desserts. The brewery features a 20-tap lineup with a variety of beer styles brewed on-site. They host regular events such as trivia nights, live music, and seasonal celebrations.
